race.comment: STYLISH EDITION (10) finished fourth at her last appearance over 1400m at Ballina on August 11 and must be respected out of the champion Waller yard. Finds a suitable assignment this time and is a great chance to break through. ROSE OF CHANTILLY (9) progressed nicely last time out when she did her best work late to finish just 0.6 lengths from the winner in third over 1400m at Dalby. Best figures measure up and is sure to run well. O'EXPLOSIVE (2) disappointed on resumption at the Sunshine Coast but should appreciatethis better. Can improve with the run under his belt. ZAYYANO (5) couldn't sprint with them last time on the Poly at the Gold Coast. Form prior is good for a rae like this though.
